senses.zh_definition: 若对应泰米尔语 பூச்சி，则指昆虫、小虫；尚无法确认输入词在马来语中具有此义。
senses.en_definition: Insect or bug, if intended as a romanization of Tamil பூச்சி; this meaning is not verified as a Malay lexical sense.
senses.ms_definition: Jika bentuk ini merujuk kepada perkataan Tamil பூச்சி, maksudnya ialah serangga; makna tersebut belum disahkan sebagai makna perkataan bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 本义项及名词词性仅说明可能对应的泰米尔语形式，不证明该词已被马来语借用。[Chennai Mathematical Institute 年报](https://www.cmi.ac.in/about/reports/cmi-annual-report-2017-2018)明确说明 poochi 在泰米尔语中意为昆虫。输入包没有 DBP 释义；本次检索亦未取得可核实的 DBP 词条，因此不能标为 official。排名 9601 仅沿用输入数据。下列短语为讨论该字符串时的示例，不是已证实的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Poochi is documented as a romanized Tamil word meaning insect in the [Chennai Mathematical Institute annual report](https://www.cmi.ac.in/about/reports/cmi-annual-report-2017-2018). That establishes a Tamil association, but does not establish borrowing into Malay. The supplied packet contains no historical citation or DBP definition. Its route into this Malay word list therefore remains unknown; assigning a Malay origin, borrowing date, or cultural history would require additional evidence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记语言标签：poochi 可能对应泰米尔语的“小虫”；标准马来语表达“昆虫”用 serangga。不要把拼写联想当成词源证据。
